system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: prompt += f"This image is a computer screenshot. Its width is {width} pixels and its height is {height} pixels. The user\'s instruction is: {instruction}.\n\n"
system_prompt_style.note: Prompts built by string templating with task/screen variables; v2 code analogous to PC-Agent prompt builders in same repo.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Inputting a screenshot into this module will ultimately yield the text and icon information present on the screen, along with their respective coordinates.
env_context_strategy.note: Perception module injects screen element list up front (file_tree_summary analogue) plus agent navigates by tapping/swiping; closest value mixed.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: The planning agent condenses lengthy, interleaved image-text history operations and screens summaries into a pure-text task progress

observation_format.evidence_quote: the second image is the annotated version of it, where icons are marked with numbers
observation_format.note: Screenshots plus perception text; set-of-marks annotation optional (use_som).

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: ### Action ###\nOpen App () or Tap () or Double Tap () or Triple Tap () or Shortcut () or Press() or Type () or Tell () or Stop. Only one action can be output at one time.
tool_call_format.note: Actions are emitted as structured text in a fixed output format and parsed by the harness; not provider function calling. Closest value json_in_text.

tool_count.evidence_quote: • Open app (app name). If the current page is the home page, this operation can be used to open the app named "app name".
tool_count.note: Operation space: Open app, Tap, Swipe, Type, Home, Stop = 6.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: we design an operation space and restricted the decision agent to selecting operations only from within this space
edit_primitive.note: GUI-only action space; no file editing.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: Below is a detailed description of the operation space:

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: we design an operation space and restricted the decision agent to selecting operations only from within this space
protocol_standardization.note: No protocol mentioned for v2; MCP appears only in later repo work (OSWorld-MCP).

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The operation of Mobile-Agent-v2 is iterative, and its process is depicted in Figure 2. Mobile-Agent-v2 has three specialized agent roles: planning agent, decision agent, and reflection agent.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: the planning agent observes the decision agent’s operation Ot−1 from the last iteration and updates the task progress T Pt−1 to T Pt
planning_granularity.note: Task progress is a maintained textual state object passed between agents.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: The three agent roles work respectively in the progress, decision, and reflection stages, collaborating to alleviate the difficulty of navigating.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: After generating the task progress, the planning agent passes it to the decision agent.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: This involves providing the agent with some operation hints in addition to the user instructions to aid the agent.
human_in_loop.note: Only pre-run knowledge injection; no in-run human gating described.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: we design a memory unit to store the focus content related to the current task from history screens
short_term_state.note: Memory unit + task progress maintained beyond messages.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: The memory unit serves as a short-term memory module that is updated as the task progresses.
long_term_memory.note: Memory is within-run only; no cross-run persistence described.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: The operation of Mobile-Agent-v2 is iterative, and its process is depicted in Figure 2.

self_verification.evidence_quote: we design the reflection agent to observe the screen state before and after a decision agent’s operation to determine whether the current operation meets expectations

retry_policy.evidence_quote: If it finds that the operation does not meet expectations, it will take appropriate measures to re-execute the operation.
retry_policy.note: Step-level retry driven by reflection verdict rather than a task-level fixed cap.

rollback.evidence_quote: If erroneous operation, the page will revert to the state before the operation.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: Stop. If the decision agent thinks that all requirements have been fulfilled, it can use this operation to terminate the entire operation process.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: All calls are made through the official API method provided by the developers.

timeouts.evidence_quote: We used Android Debug Bridge (ADB) as the tool for operating mobile devices.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: This evaluation method requires the operation tool to implement the agent’s operations in real time on an actual device.
execution_isolation.note: Actions execute on a connected physical phone via ADB; closest value remote (external device).

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: ADB can simulate all operations of Mobile-Agent-v2 in the operation space.
filesystem_access.note: Agent interacts only through the GUI action space, no direct filesystem access.

network_policy.evidence_quote: We use two mobile operation systems, Harmony OS and Android OS, to assess capabilities in non-English and English scenarios
network_policy.note: Device uses normal network (apps browse internet); no restriction described.

permission_model.evidence_quote: The decision agent operates during the decision stage, generating operations O and implementing them on the device

tracing.evidence_quote: If correct operation, the operation will be updated in the operation history, and the page will be updated to the current state.
tracing.note: Operation history kept; no structured trace export described.

replayability.evidence_quote: We fix the seed for GPT-4V invocation and set the temperature to 0 to avoid randomness.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: To evaluate the performance of Mobile-Agent-v2 on real mobile devices, we employed a dynamic evaluation method.
eval_hooks.note: Manual dynamic evaluation; no evaluation runner shipped for v2 in the evidence.

guardrails.evidence_quote: To reduce the complexity of operations, we design an operation space and restricted the decision agent to selecting operations only from within this space.

target_domain.evidence_quote: we propose Mobile-Agent-v2, a multi-agent architecture for mobile device operation assistance.
